description: This file defines the PdfLiteral class, representing raw text written directly into a PDF stream in the PDFsharp library. It includes constructors for creating literals from strings, formatted strings, and XMatrix objects, along with methods for retrieval and writing the literal.

classes.name: PdfLiteral
classes.description: Represents text written as-is into the PDF stream, potentially leading to invalid PDFs if misused.

methods.name: PdfLiteral
methods.description: Default constructor creating an empty literal.

methods.name: PdfLiteral(string value)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the literal with a specific string value.

methods.name: PdfLiteral(string format, params object[] args)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the literal with a formatted string, culture-invariant.

methods.name: FromMatrix
methods.description: Creates a PdfLiteral representing an XMatrix, formatted as a PDF array.
